note: Places you can descend into. Each path is written in local metres (x east, z south, origin at the Golden Valley box centre) and shares the shape of descent-path.json. `fadeInMs`/`fadeOutMs` are deliberately asymmetric: Session B measured the departure seam of a generated clip at twice the landing seam, so the fade is spent on the departure and the landing is close to a straight cut. `clip` is optional: a hotspot with no clip descends live along the same path, so the map works before a single frame is generated and improves the moment one lands.

hotspots.name: GCHQ — the Doughnut
hotspots.blurb: Measured here at 14.8 m tall on a 52.7 m base, courtyard and all, straight from the LiDAR difference between ground and surface. The reason the cyber campus is next door.
hotspots.clipNote: The Session C control clip, rendered from this scene. Swap in a generated descent and the seam numbers stay comparable — this path is the one seam-report.json measures.
